message.content: The APOE ε2 allele (rs7412) occurs at roughly **10–15 %** in European populations. In most large‐scale genome‑wide studies, the allele frequency is reported around **0.12–0.13** (i.e., 12–13 %). This estimate is consistent across multiple datasets (e.g., 1000 Genomes, gnomAD, and UK Biobank).
